releaseNotes:
Changed: HazMat TV name shown in the top bar (in flame colours) and in the remaining Starfleet texts; AllDebrid and TorBox pairing now show HazMat TV.

Faster: the Only cached torrents check runs in parallel and gives up on a slow service, so lists appear sooner. Includes Scrapers 1.3.83 and Resolver 1.4.35.

Fixed: DaddyLive / DLHD live sports channels play again - a new player route is used when the older ones are down. Includes Scrapers 1.3.82 and Resolver 1.4.34.

New: Prowlarr - if you run your own Prowlarr, enter its address and API key in Settings > Starfleet (Prowlarr address / Prowlarr API key) and it is searched as one more torrent source.

New: Vidrock, a free movie and TV source (1080p, up to two servers); it appears in Settings > Free Sources and can be switched off there.
Better Live TV guide: free channels whose names carry tags such as "[Geo-blocked]" or "(United States)" now find their programme guide (about 70 more channels). Includes Scrapers 1.3.81.

Faster: picking a torrent with Only cached torrents on now asks only the debrid service that has it cached, so the start no longer waits for services that do not have it. Includes Scrapers 1.3.80.

New: Settings > Premium Services > Only cached torrents (on by default). A torrent is listed only when one of your switched-on debrid services (AllDebrid, Premiumize, TorBox, Debrid-Link, Offcloud) already has it cached, so everything listed starts at once; the service that has it is shown at the end of the row, for example [PM]. Real-Debrid has no cache check, so it cannot be filtered. Turn it off to list every torrent. Includes Scrapers 1.3.79 and Resolver 1.4.33.

Fixed: in-app updates downloaded the 64-bit build on boxes and Cubes that run a 32-bit system (their CPU lists arm64 but apps run 32-bit), so the update could not install. The app now picks the build that matches how it actually runs.
Fixed: KRX18 links that came without https (for example stream.kiwi) failed with "file not found". Includes Scrapers 1.3.78 and Resolver 1.4.32.

New: every free source is switched on by default (movies and shows). Existing installs get them switched on once; you can still turn any off in Settings > Free Sources. Includes Scrapers 1.3.77.
Fixed: UFC and Formula 1 showed no events (the free calendar key had been retired, and UFC pointed at the wrong league). UFC cards and F1 race weekends now also come from ESPN.
Fixed: RareFilmm plays again, including its ok.ru videos. Rive no longer lists Vietnamese-dubbed or subtitled copies.
Fixed: iJavTorrent / ProjectJav searches for adult debrid sources returned nothing after the site changed its search.

New: two more layouts in Settings > Layout. Shuttle is a grid of purple cards, each with the rating and the kind (movie or series) on the poster and the title, kind and genre underneath. Discovery is a grid of black cards with a red tag and the rating on each poster and the title centred underneath.

Changed: the Enterprise layout now has a slim rail of icons down the left side (search, home, the sections and your profile at the bottom) and rows of posters stacked one under the other, with the next rows showing below the one you are on. The Grid layout now shows bigger posters, six across, with the title under each. Rows, the default, is unchanged.

New: Montreal Canadiens games now list the French-language broadcast as a source: RDS on weekdays (Monday to Friday) and TVA Sports on Saturdays. Includes Scrapers 1.3.76.

Fixed: DaddyLive / DLHD live channels and games work again after the site moved to a new address. The 24/7 channel list, the channel players (including the cast and plus players) and the game links that open through DaddyLive are read at the new address, the old addresses are followed to wherever the site lives now, and DaddyLive game pages that list vertex, nexa and kora players play. Includes Scrapers 1.3.75 and Resolver 1.4.31.

New: Sync accounts now also backs up the favorites you keep on the device (movies and shows, live channels, Adult), so they come back on a new device even without a TMDB account. Make a new backup after updating. When a stream you picked fails or drops, the report sent with Report broken links on now carries much more to fix it from: the link's address shape, the request headers, the app's relay route and the scraper and resolver log lines just before the failure. Includes Starfleet 2.3.695.

New: when you send a log (or the app reports a stream that failed or dropped), it now says which app it comes from and the device it runs on (model, Android version, memory, screen, storage), so problems can be looked into faster. If a stream drops while you watch, the app can report it with a short list of what the player was doing (when Report broken links is on). Send log file also tells you when Debug logging is off. Includes Starfleet 2.3.694.

Fixed: live game streams from the live-sports sites (PPV, MethStreams and the others that hand out a short-lived address) no longer die when you pick a source a minute after the list loaded. The app now asks the site for a fresh address and carries on. Includes Scrapers 1.3.74.

Fixed: Sync accounts restore now brings back Real-Debrid and Debrid-Link properly. A restored account showed as paired and on but returned no results once its token ran out, because the backup did not carry what is needed to renew it. The backup now holds each debrid account with its renewal data and the current token, and a restore puts it back (an account that already works on the device is kept). Make a new backup on your main device after updating. Also: failed-stream reports now name the real site instead of the app's own relay address.

Fixed: Sync accounts restore now switches your services back on. Premiumize, Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, TorBox, Debrid-Link, Offcloud, Easynews and the other restored logins were coming back "authorized" but still switched off, so no sources showed until you paired them again. A restore now turns each restored service on, and new backups also remember which services were off.

New: Split Screen now works without an IPTV provider: open Live TV and pick Split Screen, then put Free TV channels, movies and shows from your sources, or live sports games on each screen. Multi-Screen is always in the IPTV menu too. This version number is also the Windows and Linux desktop version.

New: Sync accounts now also carries your player and audio settings, the phone remote switches (not its pairing code) and the Report broken links switch. Pairing Telegram on a new device now checks for a waiting backup and offers to restore it straight away, so you can back up on one device and pair the next from Telegram in a couple of taps.

Fixed: torrent videos with no sound on a box or Bluetooth headset that cannot play DTS, TrueHD or Dolby Digital Plus sound: the video now carries on in the VLC player, which plays every sound format (it is fetched the first time it is needed). Phone remote: Screen sharing now also works over the internet link, so a TV on a cable and a phone on Wi-Fi that cannot see each other can still mirror and control the screen. The Downloader code now always gives the newest version.

New: Sync accounts (Settings > Sync accounts). Back up your debrid, tracker, Usenet, IPTV, Plex/Jellyfin/Emby and network share logins with a passphrase, then restore them on another device through Telegram. The copy is encrypted on the device, nobody else can read it, and it is kept for 30 days. Pair Telegram with the same account on both devices first.

Fixed: the Phone remote settings page now scrolls, so Screen sharing and New code are no longer cut off on smaller screens.

New: Phone remote screen sharing - switch on Settings > Phone remote > Screen sharing, then the phone shows the TV screen live and you tap, long-press and swipe on it as on a tablet; when a text box opens on the TV the phone's keyboard and paste type into it. The remote page is simpler: Search, Arrows, Type and Back. Home Wi-Fi link only; off by default. Also: Hold OK button on the phone, and the earlier 1.16.82 changes (donghua sources, Dailymotion fix, phone paste fix).

New: donghua (Chinese anime) sources - Soul Land 2, Perfect World, Shrouding the Heavens and more list episodes from two sites with English and Indonesian subtitles. Fixed: Paste from phone now works in the on-screen keyboard and text fields. Fixed: Dailymotion videos (anime and replays) loaded but would not play.

New: Replay > Motorsport - MotoGP, Moto2, Moto3 and WSBK race weekends (practice, qualifying, sprint, race) from two free sources, one of them a 1080p MotoGP feed. More live sports channels open (two more channel players supported).

Fixed: many video hosts (the Byse / Filemoon family, Lulu, Vidhide and more) could not be opened by the app at all, so their links never played; they open again.

New: Settings > Use free sources. Turn it off to skip the free hosters and embed players, so a title's source list comes up sooner (debrid and IPTV sources are not affected).
New: Still watching? After 4 episodes or 2 movies in a row with no remote activity the app asks; with no answer the device goes to sleep.
New: Manage groups (Settings) turns IPTV groups and Free Live TV groups on or off.
New: Start on device boot and Opening page (Settings): choose what HazMat TV opens on.
New: Back on the main screen asks Exit HazMat TV? with OK / Cancel. The Cast button can now be reached with the remote while a video plays.
New: Settings > Support project (was Buy me a coffee) lists each coin with its QR code.
New: each profile keeps its own Favorites, Continue Watching and what the app learns about your sources (best kind, quality and size listed first). A second profile no longer inherits the first one's lists.
New: AniZone anime source (multi-audio), TVNow.st live TV, and Streamic and NBAMonster game streams in Sports.
Improved: the sports and live TV sites that have several addresses are now tried on their other addresses when one is down or blocked, so fewer lists come back empty.
Improved: coming back from a game to the games list shows the last list at once and refreshes it quietly. The IPTV provider list is limited to 100.
Improved: the torrent tracker list is also taken from a public list when the built-in ones do not answer. Unused code removed.

New: Settings > Subtitle language (32 languages, Croatian included). The player track menu now offers Find <language> subtitles online.
Fixed: VAPlayer streams loaded but stopped at the first video piece; they play again.

New: Settings > Sources. Switch every debrid, free, anime, sports and live TV source on or off on its own. A fresh setup runs 3 of each kind and every live TV list; Back to the recommended ones puts it back.
New: Use debrid (Settings). Turn it off to try the free sources on their own; your debrid pairings are kept and nothing is unpaired. It is on by default and only does anything when a service is paired.
Improved: a release that several sources agree on ranks higher, and a source that gave no seeds or size now takes them from another. Fixed: a year could show as the seed count.
Fixed: in the Enterprise layout, Right from the section list reaches the widgets; the STARFLEET name in the top bar is no longer cut off in the Grid layout.
Hosts: Vidzy plays again; new addresses for Voe, MixDrop, Streamix, FireStream and the Filemoon family.

New sources: 1DDL (release site, plays through your debrid service) and 0Magnet (magnet search, plays through your debrid service).
Fixed: TorrentProject was searched at an address that is gone and returned nothing; it works again. NNMClub no longer lists its pinned rules post as a source.

New: Layout setting (Settings > Layout). Rows stays the default; Grid shows the row as a grid of posters; Enterprise puts the sections down the left, the row you are on as big posters and the rows above and below as wide tiles.
New free movie and TV sources (Bingr, Vidmoly) and new live sports sources (Bingr, SportsindX, Score808).
Changed: Replay (Past Events) moved from the top bar into Sports.

New: Continue Watching, Watchlist and Watched rows from your Simkl or Trakt account in the Movies and TV Shows sections.
New: Report broken links (Settings, shown once Telegram is paired): a link that does not play is sent to the developer with the title, the site and the error, so it can be fixed.
New: the phone remote page has a paste box, so a key or a link can be pasted from the phone into the TV (Put it in the TV box, Add to the TV box, Clear the TV box).

New: Cover and cast when a title starts (Settings): turn the cover and cast card that shows in the player while a stream loads, and for 8 seconds after it starts, on or off.

Fixed: OK.ru replays that stopped with a playback error (HTTP 400) on some connections. OK.ru replays now use its plain video servers first and fall back to the old address only if those fail.

New: Largest file size (Settings): searches leave out releases bigger than the limit you pick (No limit, 5, 10, 20, 40 or 60 GB). New: three more free movie and TV sources - MeowTV, VidUp (up to 4K) and VidBolt (1080p). Fixed: live sports from TheTVApp follow the site to its current schedule page.

New: episodes that have not aired yet now show in the season list with their air date, in yellow italics and not clickable (missing air dates are filled in from TVDB). An episode unlocks at midnight the day after it airs; Auto-play next never starts one early. New: replays - NFL, NHL and MLB full games from one more site, and soccer and MLB from a second replay feed (direct streams where available). New: live sports from LiveLive24 (tennis, basketball, golf, hockey, soccer and more).

New: more free movie and TV sources. Nexa (several servers, up to 4K), VidCore (4K servers) and VAPlayer (1080p) are searched with the other free sites. Every free link now shows its real top quality (4K / 1440p / 1080p / 720p), read from the stream itself before it is listed. Checked: the 21 streaming sites and 9 download sites you sent. Most are front ends for players already here, sit behind browser checks or logins, or only give archive files that debrid cannot play, so they were left out. Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.62. New: Soccer in Replay: full matches and halves of the Champions League, the big domestic leagues and the national teams, by day, with English and other-language commentary where the site has it. New: MegaPlay for anime: sub and dub playlists for series and films, next to AnimeParadise. New: Youplex, a torrent search that asks several indexes at once (movies, shows, anime, UFC and other replays); its releases play through your debrid service. Checked: the whole Free Media wiki video page (1,107 sites): sports, live TV, movies, TV shows, anime, download and torrent sites. Most are mirrors of sources already here or hide their links behind logins and link shorteners; what could be read and played was added. Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.61. New: Replay section (sports): finished games and fights by sport and date, NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, UFC, boxing, wrestling, racing and more. New: more free movie and TV sources: Videasy (up to 4K), CineJoy and VidFast, next to VixSrc (1080p, multi-audio) and MovieNerds (1080p down to 360p). Each link is checked before it is listed. Fixed: OK.ru replays play again; the wrestling replay list is back; taken-down Dailymotion replays are no longer listed. New: game torrents for NFL, NBA, NHL and MLB replays (play through your debrid service), matched to both teams and the right day. Better: Free TV opens faster. The channel list shows first and the programme guide loads behind it, using about a third of the memory and storage it did. Fixed: the Telegram bot welcome now says HazMat TV. Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.60. New: New TV Shows - shows whose first episode aired in the last 8 months. It is a new row on Home and on the TV tab, and a new chip (New Shows) on the TV Shows screen. Fixed: the phone keyboard (Settings > Phone remote > Keyboard and arrows) now types into every text box that asks for a login or key - IPTV, debrid, trackers, HappyFappy, Usenet, Plex/Jellyfin/Emby and SMB. The on-screen keyboard also has a Phone key that shows a QR code to type on your phone instead. New: Filter on Movies and TV Shows - only titles from a range of years (for example crime movies from 1980 to 1985), also on search results. New: hide genres per profile (kids, reality, news, soaps, talk, documentary and more) and hide the Anime, Live TV, Sports and Radio sections from the top bar (Settings > Hide genres / Sections, and in each profile). New: HappyFappy account (Settings > Adult section): with your own login its movies, scenes, VR and 3D releases are searched first. New: use the phone as a keyboard and arrow pad (Settings > Phone remote). Fixed: sports lists fall back to a second site when the first does not answer. Fixed: Phone remote - the page now opens on a phone's Chrome (the TV's small web server closed the connection too early, which showed 'This site can't be reached'). New: a Link type choice in Settings > Phone remote - Home Wi-Fi, or an Internet link that works from any network (a VPN on the phone, or a router that keeps Wi-Fi devices apart). New: Usenet indexer accounts (Settings > Premium Services): link NZBGeek, NZBPlanet, DrunkenSlug, NZBFinder or NZB.life with its API key and their releases are searched too, then played through TorBox or Premiumize. 8K: releases tagged 8K are offered on a device that can play them and kept out of the list otherwise. Faster: after you pick a torrent, every debrid service and the alternate links are checked at the same time instead of one after another, the Usenet sites are searched side by side, and a slow VR row no longer holds up the Adult tab. Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.57. Fixed: the Pair Telegram window on phones and tablets now fits the screen and scrolls, and has Open Telegram and Copy link buttons (a phone cannot scan its own screen); the code is smaller there. Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.56: live TV and sports no longer contact two former TimStreams addresses that now belong to unrelated sites. Fixed: movies and shows had lost their embed sources (RiveStream, MovieNerds and the other quick providers) since 1.16.49; they are listed again, in the same two halves. New: with VR content on, the Adult tab on Home has a VR Scenes row that streams VR scenes from the tube sites that carry them (most are the flat cut of the VR scene; the title says the format). Adult sites checked one by one: NoodleMagazine, PornRaw and JustFullPorn play again, ad tiles are no longer listed as videos, TugFlix is new, and sites that are gone or lead only to paid pages were removed (Fux, HypnoTube, TabooFantazy, WatchXXXFree, 5MoviesPorn, LetMeJizz, KRX18) (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.55). The on-screen keyboard now fits a phone held sideways: Done sits next to the text box at the top (it was cut off below the screen), the keys shrink on short screens and the keyboard scrolls if it still does not fit. This is the keyboard used to enter IPTV logins, server addresses, keys and searches. Telegram: Settings has Pair Telegram (scan the code, press Start), and Send log file now needs it: you type a few words about what went wrong and the log (keys and tokens removed) reaches the developer on Telegram with your name, and the bot thanks you. Search: typing an actor's name in Search now lists the actor, and OK opens their movies and shows. Home server library: you can add a Windows PC, NAS or router share (SMB) by address, with a login kept on the device or entered on your phone; its videos are matched like the DLNA ones and play through the app. Source lists learn which sources start fast and which keep failing, and put the reliable ones first. The cover and cast card now appears while the stream loads and stays for 8 seconds. Favorites: when your TMDB list cannot be changed the message now says the paired TMDB account must be the one that owns the list. When a movie or episode starts, its cover and the faces of the main cast appear in the lower left for 5 seconds, then fade away; Audio and subtitles now has Cast and characters, the full cast with photos and the characters they play. Typing a long key with the remote is no longer needed: Settings > Trackers (MDBList key, Trakt Client ID and Secret) has On my phone, which shows a QR code; scan it, paste the key on your phone (same Wi-Fi) and it goes straight into the TV. Source lists fill in faster: debrid and the embed providers are each searched in two halves, so the best torrent sources and the quick providers are listed first and the full search adds the rest a moment later, and RiveStream no longer holds the whole embed search up. 3D: with 3D content on, adult titles also list their 3D releases (tagged 3D), and VR releases are no longer mistaken for 3D ones (their side-by-side words describe the VR layout). VR: with VR content on, the Adult tab on Home has a VR row (XXXClub first) next to the Adult menu's VR section. The app window now starts large and can be resized on a headset. Voice: a microphone button in the top bar (next to Search) listens to you and understands phrases like 'play Marshals from yesterday', 'play the latest Marshals episode', 'play season 2 episode 3 of ...', 'next episode of ...', 'show me horror movies', 'show me new releases', 'show me action movies', 'show me Pixar' and 'show me Sydney Sweeney movies' (a genre or list opens that list, a studio opens its films, an actor opens their page). It keeps listening through short pauses and prefers titles you already watch. Your own media servers: Settings > Media servers adds Plex (link code or address and token, so a Plex on a seedbox works too), Jellyfin and Emby (address, user and password; https addresses with a path work, so a seedbox works); what is on them is offered first as a source of the same title and plays straight from the server. Settings > Home server library finds a NAS or media PC that shares its videos over DLNA / UPnP and offers its videos as sources (SMB shares are not supported yet). Linking a Plex account also adds Plex's free channels to Live TV > Free TV (new, needs more testing). Clear errors: Settings now says when a premium service plan ends or no longer works and when an IPTV portal does not answer, and an empty source list says why. Skip recap, skip intro and skip credits cards for episodes. Screen time limits and a bedtime per profile (with the Parent PIN to override). Sources you picked before are remembered and listed first next time. Find English subtitles online from the Audio and subtitles menu when a stream has none. New episode alerts and an Airing This Week row, and Because You Watched rows. Phone remote (Settings > Phone remote): search and play from a phone's browser (off by default, needs a 4-digit code). Playback stats overlay: press INFO (or choose it in Audio and subtitles) to see picture size, frame rate, decoder, dropped frames and buffer. The app now adapts to the device: lighter picture cache, fewer parallel downloads, a smaller visualizer and smaller player buffers on boxes with little memory, it gives memory back when Android asks, and it starts a little faster (startup profile). Favorites: the Radio tab now shows only your radio favorites as its top row (it was showing your movie and TV favorites and Continue Watching); hold OK on a station there to remove it. Movies shows its own Favorites row first (movies only) and TV Shows shows its own (shows only). Highlighting your profile button in the top bar now shows that profile's Continue Watching row. Next episode / next movie: the card now appears when the credits are expected to start (about the last 5 percent of the video: 1 to 2.5 minutes for an episode, 2 to 6 minutes for a film) and counts down to the end, where the next one starts by itself; OK plays it at once. It says Next episode for shows and Next movie for films in a series. New: age limits for profiles. When you add a profile (or open it in Settings > Profiles and choose Age limit) you can limit it to titles up to 14+ (PG-13 / TV-14), 7+ (PG / TV-PG) or little kids (G / TV-Y / TV-G); anything above the limit, and anything without a rating, is hidden in every list, search, actor page and Continue Watching, and a limited profile has no Adult section. Settings > Profiles > Parent PIN asks for a PIN before a limited profile can open the Profiles page or switch to a profile with fewer limits. Auto-play: when a film that belongs to a series ends (Back to the Future 1, then 2, then 3), the next film starts by itself with the best source found, and after the last one you return to the main hub; episodes play in order the same way and the last aired episode returns to the main hub (Settings > Play next episode / movie). My Teams: the team picker lists every team of the league (all NBA teams, no hockey teams under NBA), the teams you already follow are marked Following and can be unfollowed from the list. Fixed the app jumping back to the Home position whenever the on-screen keyboard opened on a tablet or phone (typing a profile name, a PIN or a search). New: a profile button in the top bar (next to Search and Cast) shows who is watching and switches profile in one step. Cast: a cast icon in the top bar and the players opens one list of the TVs and speakers on your network (Google Cast devices and DLNA TVs); pick one and whatever you play next goes to it, and you can pick it before starting a stream. Favorites: adding from a poster's hold menu or a title's page now always works - if a TMDB list is set but your TMDB account is not paired, the title is kept on your profile and shown with the list; with your TMDB account paired, every favorite you add or remove in the app is also added to or removed from your TMDB list (a private 'Starfleet Favorites' list is made if you have not set one). My Teams: each profile now keeps its own teams everywhere - the Sports widget showed the previous profile's teams, or lost your own after switching back, because its saved rows were shared between profiles; they are now kept per profile and follow your teams. Playback: videos from VOE and the hosts behind it (playmogo, vidload) download in several parts at once, so they no longer stall; live games recover at once when the stream falls behind instead of showing 'Source error' every few minutes. Games: NHL games from the OnHockey list that were filed under 'Tomorrow' in the evening show as live (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.54). Downloads: hold OK on a movie or episode to download it with your debrid service, with Settings > Downloads to follow them. Tablets: double-tap a top-bar section to put the selector on it, and the TV Guide works by touch. VR viewer: sharper picture and it stays paused when you take the headset off. The app counts how many people install it, once, anonymously (updates are not counted and nothing identifies you). Personal source keys are no longer packed in the app. Cast: the cast button in the player now hands the stream to a Chromecast or other Google Cast device over your home network, including protected sports streams. Debrid pairings, tracker logins and IPTV providers are now saved in your Google account backup (only the small login files), so they come back when you install on another device signed in to the same Google account. Games: stream links that the site itself refuses are left out of the source list and duplicates are listed once. Quest and other headsets: the app works with the controller ray and thumbstick. Fixed the next-episode countdown: pressing OK (or tapping the screen or the countdown) now starts the next episode at once; the remote's OK used to only show the control bar. Games find more streams: a hockey game opened from the OnHockey list now gets every title-based source (PPV, ReedStreams, Footy4U, SlapStreams, MethStreams and the live-site providers), and the different ways a game is named (Hurricanes vs Jets, Carolina vs Winnipeg, CAR vs WPG, a score in the title) all match; the search is given a fixed time so the list still comes quickly (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.51). Streams are no longer prepared in advance at start-up (their addresses go stale); they are made when you open the game. A channel offered as a source for a game (TSN 3) plays from your own provider when the free list has no link. Touch screens, tablets and VR headsets: the app stays inside the status and navigation bars (the top menu and bottom icons were hidden behind them), fits both the height and the width when the screen is turned, a mouse or controller ray highlights what it points at, the mouse wheel or thumbstick changes the Home row, and the built-in VR viewer zooms with the wheel and shows its controls on a tap. VR content setting, VR viewer, 3D setting, tracker marks, favorites by hold OK, IPTV as a game source, debug log and radio search from earlier builds are included. The end of an episode no longer freezes when the next one should start. Wrong episode fixed: a torrent pack that does not contain the episode you picked no longer plays a different one (episode 1); the next source is tried instead, and file names like 1x03, T01E03, Season 1 Episode 3 and E03 are recognised (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.42). Episodes that have not aired yet no longer show in a show's episode list or in Continue Watching (checked against TMDB air dates). Audio and subtitles button is always on the movie / episode player bar, lists every audio track and says when a track cannot be played on the device. Audio language: Live TV now has an Audio button in the top bar when the stream offers more than one language or track, and the movie / episode / sports player's Audio and subtitles menu now appears for streams that list several languages in one group. Fixed 'Source error' on PPV and MethStreams on boxes that also have Kodi installed: Kodi's own stream relay was holding the port this app's relay needed, so the relay never started and the streams went to the player without it. The app now uses its own port. A Referer-protected stream is also relayed when its playlist check fails (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.41). The debug log now names the host being played and whether it went through the relay. Favorites everywhere: hold OK on a Live TV channel (Live widget, TV Guide, Favorites list), on an episode, or on an Adult / Anime / Sports / Radio item to add or remove it. Live TV's dialog has a Favorites row, each plugin menu has a Favorites entry at the top, favorite episodes sit in the Favorites row of Movies / TV Shows, and the TV Guide's long-press menu adds or removes the channel (its Favorites group was already there). Watched checkmarks and 'continue where you left off' now work without any tracker account for Adult and other plays too (kept on this device per profile). Anime and Sports widgets open instantly from the last answer and refresh in the background; they are also built a few seconds after the app starts. BuffStreams sources resolve when the game search is busy (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.40). Fixed 'Source error' on sports streams: PPV, MethStreams, GStream24, SlapStreams and VoloKit. Streams whose host wants a Referer are now always played through the app's built-in relay (the hosts turned the box's player away with a 403), PPV asks for a fresh address when an edge refuses one, and VoloKit/MethStreams video hidden inside picture files is unpacked (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.39, Resolver 1.4.21). The PPV list no longer misses its window on a slow box (games' page sites are fetched ahead of time). Adult: hosts are no longer written off after one slow connect, Streamtape links resolve again, and the torrent site check works (cloudscraper added). PPV sports (and the other sports feeds on the same streaming edges) play again: their video is hidden inside picture files, and the check that unpacks it could be skipped after one slow answer, so the player was handed pictures it cannot read. Those streams are now always unpacked, a slow check no longer drops a source, and the relay asks again when an edge refuses a segment (Starfleet Scrapers 1.3.36). New in Settings: Debug logging (On/Off) records what the player, sources and resolvers do, and Send log file uploads that log with keys and tokens removed and shows a short address to pass on (or saves it on the device if the upload services do not answer). Live TV: a channel that stays on 'loading' while its sound plays (the picture stays blank until the app is force-stopped) now gets a fresh player after 12 seconds before you are told it is taking too long. Fixed choosing a channel from a different category or section playing the channel that was already on (it needed a second try): the player was still using the old category's channel list. The TV Guide now opens on the last channel you watched (from Live TV, the guide or channel zapping), looking further down the list for it when needed. Fixed channels taking too long to load and playing sound only after changing the playback speed a few times: the replaced player kept its video decoder and the box ran out of video memory; it is now freed at once. Fixed the TV Shows, Anime, Sports and Settings widgets not loading: moving past a tab before it had finished loading marked it as loaded-and-empty for good (and it was kept that way for ten minutes); now a tab that was cut short or came back empty is loaded again the next time it is highlighted. Update downloads now use a file name that carries the version, so an update can never hand out an older copy from a download cache (the 32-bit box was served 1.16.8 as 1.16.9). Fixed the picture freezing while the sound plays on after choosing a speed: the video view stayed attached to the old player when the player was rebuilt. The old player is now stopped, the picture is attached to the new one, and the new one keeps the title's watch progress. Widgets load much faster. Favorites that come from a TMDB list are now kept on the device (and refreshed in the background) instead of being downloaded page by page every time; the Python side is started when the app opens instead of when the first widget needs it; the app no longer limits itself to 5 downloads at a time, which was queueing the ten pages of every list; and the Home widgets now appear one by one as each list arrives. Fixed the player closing right after a stream started (a stream that failed or stopped early was taken for a finished video; now only a video watched to its end returns to its widget or episode list). Fixed the speed button (1.25x/1.5x/1.75x) not changing the speed: your box sends the sound out untouched whatever the setting, which cannot be sped up, so choosing a speed now restarts the player at the same spot with the sound decoded by the app. Widgets load faster: Favorites and Continue Watching appear at once from what is on the device (before the Simkl/Trakt lists are asked for), and the Movies and TV Shows widgets appear one by one as each list arrives instead of all at the end. Fixed the player speed button (1.25x / 1.5x / 1.75x) not actually speeding the video up: audio passthrough and tunneled video are played untouched by the hardware, which cannot change speed, so choosing a speed now restarts the player at the same spot with the sound decoded by the app. The VLC engine now keeps the chosen speed when the stream (re)starts. When a movie ends it returns to that movie's widget, and when an episode ends it returns to that show's episode list (on the season that was playing). New setting, Settings > Play next episode: when on, the next episode starts by itself with the best source found. Backing out of a movie or show now returns to the widget row and poster it was opened from, not the Home position; the hub keeps its widgets so it comes back instantly. Favorites, Continue Watching and watchlist titles are now saved on the device too (kept through app updates), so those rows appear at once instead of waiting on the network. New playback speed button in the player controls: cycles 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 1.75x. The new HazMat TV icon and TV banner. Back now steps out one level at a time. In the player the first Back closes the control panel and the next leaves; a movie or show started from the Home widgets returns to that widget, in its section and on its poster; in Live TV Back goes channel, then categories, then the hub's Live TV section; in the TV Guide Back opens the groups, then returns to the hub; from anywhere in the hub Back goes to the Home position and one more Back exits the app. The Movies, TV Shows and Home lists are saved on the device and shown at once on the next start (and kept through app updates), then refreshed in the background every six hours. Fixed the TV Guide closing the app when a group was chosen. The Home carousels no longer stop at the first few titles: every favorite, every Continue Watching and watchlist title and ten pages of each TMDB list (New Releases, Top Rated, Popular, Upcoming...) are there. Live TV and the TV Guide use the same colors as the rest of the app. Coming back from a channel puts you on the channel you were watching, in the category you were in. The TV Guide is redesigned in the TiviMate style: a preview and program details at the top, channels down the left, a time line across; Left / Right move between programs, Up / Down between channels, OK plays, hold OK previews a live channel or sets a reminder, Left on the first program opens the groups. Movies and shows you have watched on Simkl or Trakt show a check mark (and their episodes in the episode list). The player has an Audio and subtitles picker (another audio track, other subtitles, or off), Left / Right skip during playback, and Down steps into the control bar (Left / Right move along it, OK presses a button, Up goes back to the picture); the bar stays up while you use it. Watched episodes (and movies) show a check mark, and sources are listed IPTV first, then best quality first, then most seeders. Movies and shows now list debrid sources (torrents and release-site hosters) once a debrid service is paired, and picking one plays it through your service. Pairing a premium service or tracker (Simkl, Trakt, WeTrakr, MDBList) shows a QR code next to the address and code, a service that does not answer the first time is retried, and finishing a pairing no longer shows a load error. Movies and TV Shows have a Favorites row, hold OK on a poster to add or remove a favorite, and Radio shows your Continue Watching and Favorites. HazMat TV is now built the Starfleet way: Home with widgets (highlight Movies, TV Shows, Live TV, Anime, Sports, Radio or Settings to see its widgets), autoplay trailers in English, Continue Watching, Favorites (on your profile or a TMDB list), cast with photos (open an actor to see everything they have been in), release and air dates, certification and the content advisory. Pair premium services and your trackers (Simkl, Trakt, WeTrakr, MDBList) in Settings; IPTV movies and shows are a source on every title and listed under IPTV Movies / IPTV TV Shows. Profiles, My Teams alerts (including the FloHockey leagues), split screen (side by side or top and bottom, mixing IPTV, movies and live sports), and Left / Right now skip back and forward during playback. Your IPTV providers, debrid pairings and trackers carry over from the old version. Needs Android 7 or newer.
